meta.name: Legacy RPN sheet conversion
meta.scope: The four items of legacy-rpn-sheet.csv, converted to the schema without re-rating them.

included: the four items listed in legacy-rpn-sheet.csv
excluded: every element the sheet does not name
boundary.security: The sheet records no security component and no security boundary; the boundary is left undeclared by the conversion and belongs to the first review.

ground_rules: The conversion carries the sheet's own values and does not re-rate them.
Every field the sheet does not supply is filled with a declared default and counted in meta.history, never invented.

assumptions.text: The sheet does not name the scale its S, O and D were rated against; the pin to scales version one is the conversion's declared default and needs the sheet author's confirmation.

The sheet does not classify the payment gateway dependency; the conversion's declared default is strength strong, because the sheet's own Effect column says a failed authorization leaves the cart unconfirmed, and it needs the sheet author's confirmation.

history.change: Converted from legacy-rpn-sheet.csv on 2026-09-07. Column mapping: Item to elements[].name and its derived id; Function to functions[].statement; Failure Mode to chains[].failure_mode; Effect to chains[].effects.end; Cause to chains[].causes[0].text; Current Controls to chains[].controls[0], whose kind is read from the cell's own prefix; S, O and D to chains[].ratings.S|O|D.value; RPN read for reference only and never copied, priority.rpn being recomputed by priority.ts from the retained ratings; Recommended Action to chains[].actions[0].description; Owner to chains[].actions[0].owner; Status to chains[].actions[0].status; Justification to chains[].ratings.S|O|D.rationale. Ratings retained with review status authored, by J. Legacy, date 2025-11-30, both read from the sheet's header rows. Declared defaults, each counted here rather than invented: rationale substituted with the text 'converted from legacy-rpn-sheet.csv; no rationale recorded' on 1 of 4 rows; evidence_kind set to estimate on 4 of 4 rows because the sheet has no evidence column; trigger left empty on 4 of 4 rows; effects.local and effects.next_level set to 'not recorded in legacy-rpn-sheet.csv' on 4 of 4 rows because the sheet carries a single Effect column; functions[].for_whom set to 'not recorded in legacy-rpn-sheet.csv' on 4 of 4 functions; controls[].status set to existing and controls[].evidence.kind set to none on 4 of 4 rows because the sheet records neither; actions[].target_date set to the conversion date 2026-09-07 on 4 of 4 actions because the sheet has no target date column; dependency.strength set to strong on the 1 of 4 elements typed external_dependency, because section 6 requires a dependency block on that kind and the sheet records no classification; the choice is recorded as an open assumption. The sheet's stated RPN differs from the product of the retained ratings on 1 of 4 rows and the sheet's value is recorded in that row's history.
